Test Case Name: Test case to verify NFC functionality  of the Non-Driver PCB
Pre Action:
1.Power Supply - ON
2.Connect the Trace32 hardware to the PC with  target board.
3.Run SmartBuApp.bat to open GUI Panel
4.Go to Section Setting
5.Click on Brouse option to select elf  > To Falsh elf
6.Select Variant - Non NFC Version
7.Click on Connect Trace32 and wait for connection
8.Click on Start Code (Go) and  verify Debugger Running
Test Steps:
1.Connect NFC Antenna between TP-801 and TP-803 
2.Tap valid NFC Card on Antenna
3.Read Signal  at TP-703
